<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Rajya Sabha nominations:</strong> The BJP has fielded Dinesh Arya from Uttarakhand and former TMC MP Koel Mallick from West Bengal for the upcoming biennial Rajya Sabha elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political sparring:</strong> Tensions between the SP and Congress have escalated following remarks from an SP MP criticizing Rahul Gandhi’s decision to skip the Amethi constituency during the 2024 Lok Sabha polls.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Library relocation:</strong> The Supreme Court has taken suo motu cognisance of the potential relocation of the 135-year-old Central Secretariat Library amid the ongoing Central Vista redevelopment project.</li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission staffing:</strong> The Supreme Court has dismissed an appeal challenging the appointment of a private secretary to the Chief Election Commissioner, affirming the commission&#x27;s discretionary powers under current rules.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxOakxqME9tMk1uN2xMLXBWSW1CWkdCZDMwdF9QMXQ0Z2xFSFFGeHZLZWMtQTZETHp3X0FRRHRsZVBiVjF4M3JoaTBrdnRORGcyRjJaT0dtSzZldVQ1b2RPNG9STmt1dy1TRjNYb202eUs2WnQ1d0FKZ1VOSGlPM0xZbmJ6R1RHcW5zTFVtd3EyOVB1MExHMXFKNzl0cGJfc05FTzJRLUtMMW5GMFRleW9PWTVWNnZrclJFZ2tXWTZlQjNlbEVJeGhsT1V3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative setback:</strong> A Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at implementing women’s reservation in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies has failed to pass in the Lok Sabha.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
